run_pipeline_flux_img2img: run the FluxImg2ImgPipeline to generate images from a prompt and input image with configurable strength and inference steps
encode_prompt_flux: encode text prompts into T5 and CLIP embeddings for the Flux image-to-image pipeline
prepare_latents_flux_img2img: prepare latent variables from an input image by encoding through VAE and adding noise at a given timestep
calculate_shift_flux: calculate the shift parameter for the FlowMatchEulerDiscreteScheduler based on image sequence length
retrieve_timesteps_flux: retrieve scheduler timesteps from num_inference_steps or custom timesteps or sigmas for Flux diffusion
